response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced senior/staff-level fullstack engineer whose technical profile comfortably exceeds the role's requirements: strong TypeScript/Node.js, React, REST and web architecture, SQL, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS (CDK), and current exposure to LLM/agentic tooling — all of which map to the required and nice-to-have skills. He is Berlin-based, so the on-site requirement is workable. The core mismatch is seniority: the position is explicitly entry level with 'first to several years' of experience, while he has 15+ years and a track record of leading, mentoring and founding projects. This raises real risks around compensation alignment, motivation, and retention, and the posting is not structured to leverage his strengths. Worth a screening call primarily to test genuine motivation for a junior-scoped role — or to consider him for a more senior opening.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js, React and web architecture experience across many products
Strong nice-to-have coverage: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, LLM/AI-agent tooling
Berlin-based with proven craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, teaching)
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an explicitly entry-level IC role
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (mostly MongoDB/MySQL)
Only basic German for an on-site German energy-consulting/construction context

key_factors.factor: Core stack fit (TypeScript, React, REST, cloud)
Berlin location plus AI/ML and infrastructure extras
